Mon miracle, I... must make very certain you understand something before I tell you this next anecdote of mine.
LyonDating
It is important to me that you are paying very close attention to these next words that I send you. Do you understand?
你讓我覺得很緊張。怎麼了？
對，我在這。請說。
Nothing is wrong - quite the opposite. That is what is so imperative for you to comprehend - the dire consequences from which I wish to free you, should you assume they might follow.
+5 Chemistry
我在聽。
You're not making much sense.
Dire consequences of... what?
Thank you. Before I begin I wish to assure you that there is nothing wrong - however, therein lies perhaps the dire consequences from which I wish to free you, should you assume they might follow.
+5 Chemistry
是的。我對此深有體會。
容許我重新開始過。
I am aware that I can be construed by many, and in fact, very well might be, in reality, to be... unwell. At the very least, I am not entirely of sound mind.
I have long since come to be at peace with this. It does not trouble me any longer. The visions that plague me - the voices - I have come to find ways to live with them without fear or hatred.
(Lately, I think, a little out of spite if I might be honest, but that is neither here nor there.)
But I wish you to understand that if you were to end this between us - this bond that I thought was previously heretofore impossible between myself and another -
If you were to ever let your heart wander away from mine?
I will endure, mon miracle.
I will not be consumed by that which has plagued me.
Check boolean LyonAllRight
I will be, to use your colloquialism, "all right." I will find cause to smile and laugh once more.
true
I will survive. I will be fine. I will find cause to smile and laugh once more.
false
Oh, Lyon... you aren't a burden to me.
Are you... saying you want to end things between us?
I am simply attempting to free you of any perceived hardship you might feel on my account...
No! Anything of the sort! I am simply attempting to free you of any perceived hardship you might feel on my account.
Your pain... echoes a kind of my own. It'd never be a hardship to help you through it.
I can't describe what draws me to you. But you will never be a duty or a burden.
[Break up.] This is all just become too much for me, I'm sorry. It might be best to end things here.
To which I cannot express how much my heart breaks in turn for you. But that I am forever grateful that our lonely ghosts of pain have found each other.
To which I cannot properly express my gratitude, and I do not think any words ever can.
Yes. Of course. It would be... hypocritical to accept any other answer at this point in time...
But now that I have gone through great pains to go through what has been a most spectacularly self-indulgent preamble...
I understand completely. And I wish you nothing but the best. And I will cherish all the moments we have spent together.
For a guy who started off silent, you really did get wordy.
I find them endearing, don't worry.
You could've just said "I'll be fine, you know, if we ever go our separate ways."
I will remember them in my soul, even if they vanish from my mind. Farewell.

Bah! If you did not wish to be privy to the inner workings of my mind, you should not have gone poking about. You are entirely to blame for that.
I am quite glad you enjoy my wanderings. This is precisely why I choose to speak as little as I do. Can you imagine enduring this in person? Marie would have put me down years ago like a mad dog.
There is a certain amount of irreverence and sarcasm to which you naturally prevail that I could never hope to ascend. I will leave it to you.

Nevertheless, all of this was meant to serve as pretext to a story that will now seem quite short in comparison to the rest...
- 里昂
I awoke last night from a nightmare. When I did, shadows surrounded me. This is nothing foreign or new in my state of mind. They loomed over my bed, and would not clear.
Chat ends.
I was not frightened of them, for I knew they could not harm me. However, they would not be gone from my mind, either. There was only one I knew to be rid of them.

Pushing up from bed, I dressed as best I could, staggering through the blurry vision of the continued nightmare. I grasped my thurible and fell to my knees in the middle of my floor, and prepared to... well.
I prepared to "clear my mind." We shall leave it at that.
But as I shut my eyes, my mind wandered. My thoughts drifted... to you, mon miracle...
The sound of your voice. The touch of your hand upon my shoulder...
And the visions... fled. They abandoned their post, chased away by the stronger ghost... of you.
I... stood. Placed my thurible upon the nightstand, and... opted to walk through the sand of the Sanctum instead...
I can understand why you felt the need for the preamble, now.
我不知道應該說什麼……
Yes. Well. On my walk I... instantly realized the dark danger of such a moment. That you might... come to think it a responsibility - come to see me as chains that weigh you down.
+5 Chemistry
I beg of you - I pray, to any god or gods on high or below - that you never do. This is a gift you have given me, and each time in its newness I will cherish it.
There are no words needed, mon miracle...
Vow to me, mon miracle - that should the time come, that I have become for you an empty cage... you will be free of me.
On my walk I... instantly realized the dark danger of such a moment. That you might... come to think it a responsibility - come to see me as chains that weigh you down.
I shall be no hollow prison for those I love. Not for you. Not for Marie.
[Break up.] I - I can't. I can't promise that, I'm sorry.
我發誓。
+10 Chemistry
+10 Chemistry
Thank you. Thank you, mon miracle, for your honesty. This took bravery, in this moment, and I commend you for it.
Thank you. Thank you, mon miracle...
我會好好珍惜我們一起度過的所有時光。我這份認真遠遠超乎你的想像。
I am suddenly so very tired, as if... a great weight has been lifted from my shoulders. I fear I must go lie down.
I will remember them in my soul, even if they vanish from my mind. Farewell.
